name: luke-voice
description: Ceci, a voice assistant beside your Claude Code session: talk it through, and it sends the work to Claude. Free local voice by default, ElevenLabs optional. On/off button above the prompt.

voice_provider.title: Voice: local (free, default) or elevenlabs
voice_provider.description: local: the free voice that runs on your computer (Whisper + Kokoro in the call window; the brain is Claude Sonnet on your Claude account). elevenlabs: the ElevenLabs voice agent, which needs the API key below. Empty: ElevenLabs while a key is set, else local. /luke-voice voz switches it too.

api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key (optional)
api_key.description: Only for the ElevenLabs voice. The local hub creates your voice agent and starts calls with it. Falls back to the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY environment variable. It never leaves the hub process.
